title: Read query data
summary: Ruby on Rails: Read query data. Leave out q.
introduction: params also contains query values. Open GET /search?q=cat. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Read query data with Ruby on Rails

blocks.text: Create a practice project with rails new school --api --skip-active-record. Enter it. Put each labelled section into its named file, then run bin/rails server -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8000. No database is needed.

blocks.title: Read query data
blocks.code:
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
get "/search", to: "lesson#search"
end

# app/controllers/lesson_controller.rb
class LessonController < ActionController::API
def search
 render json: { term: params[:q] || "" }
end
end

blocks.text: The query value q is present, so the fallback is not needed.
